transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I... well, I guess I'm here because for months now I've just been trying to get people to understand what's going on. It's... it's my husband's family. They're quietly messing with our money. And our good name. 

I don't really want to get into all of it right now, but... I see things happening. Little billing errors keep showing up at my work, or... or someone at church will suddenly act funny toward me. People act like I'm making it up, but no matter what records anyone pulls up... I know it ties back to them. That's all.
Have you ever heard voices that other people could not hear?
No. I don't hear voices. It's just... regular things happening around me. Real things.
Do you believe people are deliberately trying to harm or deceive you?

Yes. I mean... I already said that. They are. My husband's family, I mean. It's not... it's not a secret, they're doing it on purpose. The billing mistakes at work, the way people at church look at me now... they're doing it to ruin our name and mess with our finances. I know they are. Even if the paperwork doesn't show it right away, they're behind it.
Have you had any experiences that seem impossible, like your thoughts being controlled or broadcast, or other people inserting thoughts into your mind?
No. Nothing like that. Just... what I told you. They're just doing things behind my back. My thoughts are my own.
Have you noticed any things that other people around you do not seem to notice, such as seeing things or hearing voices?
No. I thought I just... I already said I don't hear voices. And I don't see things either. I just see what's actually going on.
Have you always been suspicious that other people might be trying to trick, exploit, or harm you?
No. I... I'm not like that. I never had a reason to be, until... until they started doing all this. Before that, everything was just normal.
Have you been this suspicious of people in other parts of your life as well?
No. Just... just at work. With them. That's it.
Have you generally been suspicious of other people for as long as you can remember, even before these recent problems started?
I just answered that. No. I haven't been.
Have you had any other fixed beliefs that others would say are clearly untrue, besides the one about your husband’s family?
No. I don't... I don't have beliefs that aren't true. I just know what I see. So, no. There's nothing else.
When did you first start believing that your husband’s family was doing this to you?
About nine months ago. It started... right around the time we had some trouble with them. Over money, mostly. And what they were expecting from us for the holidays. That's when it began.
Have you had this kind of strong suspicion about other people or groups, outside of your husband’s family and work, at any other times in your life?
No. I don't... I don't have issues with other people. It's just them.
Have you always been a very distrustful or suspicious person, even before these recent problems started?
No. I wouldn't say that. I've always just... minded my own business. I don't go looking for problems.
Have you generally had a hard time trusting other people for most of your adult life?
No. I... I've never had an issue with that. I trust people just fine. It's really just... just this one situation.
Outside of this situation, do you usually think other people may be trying to deceive or harm you?
No. I... I don't think that. Like I just said, it's really only them. I don't have problems with anyone else.
Before these recent problems started, did people in your life often say you were suspicious or hard to trust?
No. I... nobody has ever said anything like that to me. I just do my work and go home. I don't really know why we keep going over this.
Before the past nine months, did you ever tend to distrust other people or assume they had bad motives?
No. I... I feel like I just answered this. Before all this started, no. I didn't go around thinking people had bad motives. Everything was fine before.
